wiki.title: John R. Bell IV
wiki.extract: John Richard Bell, IV, (born May 18, 1979) is an American politician. A member of the Republican Party, he has represented the 10th district (including Wayne, Greene, and Johnston counties) in the North Carolina House of Representatives since 2013.
